name: anxiety
description: A prediction that a specific kind of discomfort or danger is likely to happen, causing stress and a desire to avoid the problem.

variations.name: physical anxiety
variations.description: Perception that something that causes pain could to happen to you or an important other.
examples: avoiding certain foods for health reasons

variations.name: social anxiety
variations.description: Perception that something is happening or about to happen that could negatively change how people look at you.

variations.name: performance anxiety
variations.description: Something important is going to happen soon and you will be expected to perform an action that you're not sure you'll be able to do.

comparisons.description: Anxiety and fear are sometimes used interchangably. Fear is major anxiety driven by something that could significantly affect your body or identity that floods the brain with fight-or-flight chemicals.

commentaries.quote: Anxiety is the dizziness of freedom.
Worrying is like paying a debt you don’t owe.

Anxiety can cause inaction, which is, in its most basic sense, a loss of freedom. What is possible may never actualize and one may lose the present by tending to an imagined future. One becomes immobilized and unable to meet needs and realize goals and aspirations.
commentaries.attribution: Peg O'Connor, 'Anxiety Is a Part of Human Nature'

commentaries.quote: There are many ways that things can go 'wrong'. We only get anxious about the ones that we care about controlling, the ones that could cast a shadow on one of our important indentities. Deep down, we recognize that the modern world and modern identities cannot exist without a lot of careful and exhausting control.

conditions: A prediction that a specific kind of discomfort or danger is likely to happen.
A desire to avoid the problem.
